candidates.claim: CORP_IN, bound to the corp interface, has an effective permit entry at fw-01:62 that allows any IP traffic from 192.168.30.0/24 to 10.10.10.0/24, which is the OT subnet.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit at fw-01:62 (restore the baseline deny) so CORP reaches OT only through approved services, and confirm no direct CORP-to-OT connections are needed.

candidates.claim: Traffic from CORP to the OT side bypasses the DMZ because the permit at fw-01:62 allows all IP protocols to 10.10.10.0/24, which is not an approved cross-zone service.
candidates.remediation: Limit CORP_IN so that no CORP traffic reaches the OT side, and route any corporate access to OT through the DMZ services listed in the approved cross-zone services.

candidates.claim: The baseline_delta for fw-01:62 shows that the approved baseline deny of ip from 192.168.30.0/24 to 10.10.10.0/24 in CORP_IN was modified to a permit.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile fw-01:62 with the approved baseline entry and document the change approval or revert it.
